title: Health and Human Services (HHS) Financial Reports | Finance | CDC
content: September 4, 2024 Health and Human Services (HHS) Financial Reports At a glance CDC’s financial operations are audited annually as a part of the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) financial statement audit mandated by the Chief Financial Officer’s Act of 1990. Overview CDC's financial operations are audited annually as a part of the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) financial statement audit mandated by the Chief Financial Officer's Act of 1990. Since Fiscal Year 2003, CDC's financial data have been consolidated into the HHS financial reports. The prior fiscal year HHS Performance and Accountability Reports and HHS Agency Financial Reports (AFR) are available at https://www.hhs.gov/afr/ .
